requirement: Versioned control, requirement, risk, evidence, owner, test and criterion relationships; support many-to-many and effective dates
Derive expected observations from transactions, schedules, triggers and tenant scope, including zero-activity attestation
Capture immutable production evidence with producer identity, source references, correlation and integrity verification
Evaluate expected vs observed windows, late arrivals, silent producers, partial batches and suppressed failures
Return Pass, Fail, InsufficientEvidence, StaleEvidence, AwaitingReview, NotApplicable with versioned explanation
Detect shared root cause and inherited controls without double-counting effectiveness
Open, assign, prioritize, investigate, approve remediation, retest and independently close
Separate actor, preparer, owner, approver, reviewer and auditor; prevent agent self-attestation
Report expected, observed, verified, late, missing, untestable and excluded evidence with denominators
Versioned sampling plans, population completeness, sample provenance, test outcomes and deviations
Sponsor-approved severity, affected transactions, duration, recurrence and legal/financial exposure
Agents can triage and prepare; consequential approvals and assurance signoff require designated authority
Scope monitoring, dashboards, audit exports and access to partner/sponsor/entity boundaries
Redact secrets and unnecessary PII; retention, legal hold, access review and deletion policy
Produce reproducible time-window packages, source manifest, gaps, exceptions, tests and reviewer signoffs
Time-limited least-privilege read-only auditor workspaces, requests, exports and activity history
Reevaluate control dependencies and evidence expectations when policy, code, API, model or owner changes
Monitor evidence collector availability, queue backlog, integrity checks, restore exercises and fail-closed boundaries
Bind grant approval, GL, NAV, custody, bank and payment simulation events to independent assertions
Distinguish law, sponsor policy, observed charity facts and pending counsel review
Governed versioned endpoints, subscriptions, pagination, idempotency, authorization and webhooks
Signed short-lived context, read-only by default, scoped drilldowns and secure host integration
Same period, denominator, status and evidence references across screens, widgets and exports
Never display SOC 2 compliant, certified or effective based on design or unverified synthetic evidence
